answer: Duplicate identities fragment stake below the tide threshold, forfeiting rewards, while legitimate agents compound. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted proof-of-personhood: each agent must lock a bonded stake and solve a rotating challenge seeded by a cedar hash of prior epoch work. A raven audit randomly samples submissions; faked personas lose their bond, making attacks costlier than honest participation. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
